title: Eid Mubarak Fonts, Symbols & Kaomoji Generator | UltraTextGen
meta_description: Style an Eid Mubarak greeting live, copy crescent moon and mosque emoji, kaomoji, curated ASCII art, and ready-made phrases with native script, romanization, and translation.
hero_tagline: Type a name or wish and style it in curated fonts, then copy crescent moons, mosque and prayer emoji, kaomoji, and ASCII art — or tap a ready-made greeting to style it instantly.
intro: Eid Mubarak marks two of the biggest greeting-and-gifting occasions on the Islamic lunar calendar: Eid al-Fitr, celebrated at the end of Ramadan, and Eid al-Adha, marked during the Hajj season a couple of months later. Both are celebrated with prayer, family gatherings, sweets, and messages wishing loved ones a blessed holiday. This page gathers everything for styling that greeting: curated fonts you can preview on your own text, the crescent moon and mosque emoji people actually paste, kaomoji for a joyful chat message, a few original ASCII art pieces, and a phrase bank of real greetings — native script, romanization, and translation — that style instantly when you tap them.
date_window: twice a year, set by the lunar Islamic (Hijri) calendar — Eid al-Fitr after Ramadan, and Eid al-Adha around two months later
